description: Canonical, machine-readable D1 migration manifest for WorkUnit OS. Two INDEPENDENT lanes (CONTROL_DB, TENANT_DB_DEFAULT). Every committed migration MUST appear in exactly one lane — there is no `deferred` escape hatch, because an operationally invisible migration produces a bootstrap schema the application cannot use. Existing migration SQL is IMMUTABLE after this manifest is introduced; changes are append-only. Each `sha256` is SHA-256 over the file bytes and is pinned. This file NEVER contains database IDs, secrets, identities, or seed values.

applyModes.replay_safe: The raw SQL may be re-executed against an already-migrated database with no effect and no error (every statement is `IF NOT EXISTS`-guarded). Applied on every run.
applyModes.once: The raw SQL is NOT re-runnable (e.g. `ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN`, which SQLite cannot guard with `IF NOT EXISTS`). Applied exactly once, recorded in the `__atra_d1_migrations` ledger, and skipped on later runs. Requires an `effect` probe so the ledger and the real schema reconcile deterministically.

TENANT_DB_DEFAULT.note: The ONE canonical source of `tenant_databases.schema_version` for a TENANT_DB_DEFAULT registry row. It is NOT an arbitrary operator value: bootstrap prepare and apply both require the operator-supplied CF_D1_BOOTSTRAP_SCHEMA_VERSION to equal it exactly. `planDigest` pins the tenant lane this version describes — changing the active plan makes `validateManifest` fail with registry_plan_digest_mismatch until the version and digest are updated together. Version 2 describes the lane INCLUDING 0006 (action_previews.created_by_user_id); version 1 described the pre-0006 schema, which the application cannot use.

Four-eyes approval support. `D1ActionPreviewRepository.create()` ALWAYS inserts action_previews.created_by_user_id, so this migration is REQUIRED for a usable tenant database: it is an ordered, ACTIVE lane member, never deferred. It is `once` because SQLite has no `ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS`; the ledger — not raw replay-safety — is what makes re-running the lane safe.
